subject: VP/CTO sync and lab-demo scheduling
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@atlasretail.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposing VP/CTO sync and a hands-on lab demo

Hi Samir — great conversation earlier today. Thanks for walking through Atlas Retail's ingestion and latency pain points; I captured a few quick notes below.

Top takeaways from discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference tail latency for personalization pipeline (95th pct target: <120ms)
- Current constraints: bursty traffic during promos, on-prem data residency for PII
- Success metrics: 20–30% reduced cost per 1M tokens and consistent P95 latency

Recommended next steps to unblock the pilot:
1) Executive alignment — 30 min with your VP of Engineering and Redwood's VP (high-level SLOs, procurement cadence)
2) Technical deep-dive + lab demo — 60 min with your CTO/lead infra engineer and our infra/solutions team to run a small dataset through a live endpoint

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue May 11: 10:00–10:30 or 16:00–17:00
- Wed May 12: 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00

I've attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan and a short demo deck for context. If you prefer, share a couple of times that work and I'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Atlas_MVP_MAP_v1.pdf, redwood-demo-deck.pptx

From: Samir Patel <samir@atlasretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@atlasretail.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposing VP/CTO sync and a hands-on lab demo

Thanks Rachel — this is helpful. Asha and I reviewed and the exec sync + lab demo makes sense.

For the VP sync, my VP (Kiran Desai) is available on Tue May 11 at 16:00 PT. For the technical demo, our CTO (Leila Martinez) prefers Wed May 12 afternoon. Can you loop in your technical lead and Redwood's VP? Also we need the demo to include a quick run using our anonymized sample payload so we can validate the KV cache behavior.

Once you confirm who from Redwood will join, I'll send calendar invites.

Samir
Samir Patel | Head of ML Platforms, Atlas Retail
samir@atlasretail.com | +1 (212) 555-6677

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Asha Rao <asha@atlasretail.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposing VP/CTO sync and a hands-on lab demo

Appreciate the quick reply and the clarity on availability. Marcus (Solutions Engineering) and Neha (Customer Success) are looped — Marcus will lead the lab demo and will have our infra test harness ready for the anonymized payload.

Planned agenda for the two meetings:
- VP/CTO Exec sync (30m): business goals, success metrics, timelines, procurement checkpoints, and initial capacity targets
- Technical lab demo (60m): architecture review, live endpoint with your sample payload, KV cache demonstration, quantization/throughput options, and a short Q&A

Confirming slots:
- VP/CTO exec sync: Tue May 11, 16:00–16:30 PT (Kiran Desai + Rachel Kim + Redwood VP — I will confirm Redwood VP availability and add calendar invite shortly)
- Technical lab demo: Wed May 12, 14:00–15:00 PT (Leila Martinez + Marcus Lin + Neha Kapoor + Rachel Kim)

Samir — is May 11 at 16:00 PT good for Kiran? If yes we'll finalize the VP name from Redwood and send invites. Marcus — can you confirm you can run the lab demo Wed 14:00 PT and we'll prep the anonymized sample ahead of time (Samir will share).

Thanks,
Rachel

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@atlasretail.com>, Asha Rao <asha@atlasretail.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposing VP/CTO sync and a hands-on lab demo

Confirmed from my side — I have the infra harness and a parallelized runner ready. Wed May 12 14:00 PT works. I'll request the anonymized payload from Samir's team now and will prepare a small run (1000 tokens, mixed sequence lengths) to show cache hit improvement and P95 latency.

I'll also include a short pre-demo checklist for your infra folks (TCP ports, sample volume, and required account creds). Rachel — when you have the Redwood VP name/time for the Tue slot, drop the calendar invite and I'll add a 10-minute pre-brief for the demo run-through on Wed at 13:30 PT.

-Marcus
